name: Imbued Strand
description: Cast a strand of soul force shot through with qi so that it holds the soul and the qi round it together.

name: Laced Wrap
description: Lace a wrap of qi and soul force before the student that bears both a blow of qi and a soul-strike.

name: Pulse Hitch
description: Hitch a line to a far soul on a pulse of qi and cross to it in one step.

name: Qi Gyve
description: Close a gyve on an opponent's qi flow that presses down the rush of force through the body.

name: Meridian Gauge
description: Run a fine strand along an opponent's meridians and read how freely the qi runs through them.

name: Cording Strike
description: Strike with a cord of qi bound to the soul so that the blow lands on body and soul together.

name: Meridian Shackle
description: Shackle the main channels of an opponent's qi so that the force cannot be gathered or moved.

name: Meridian Crush
description: Crush the shackled channels inward so that the opponent's qi is driven back on itself.

name: Qi Immurement
description: Wall in an opponent's qi so that no technique can draw on it until the wall is cut.

name: Knotted Current
description: streams: Bind Soul + Qi; knot the flow of qi into the binding of the soul so that the opponent is held in body and soul alike and cannot move or gather force.

name: Living Strand
description: Cast a strand that puts out small roots and holds an opponent's soul where it stands.

name: Sap Wrap
description: Wrap the student in a sappy living cord that takes a soul-strike and closes over it.

name: Vital Hitch
description: Root a hitch in a living soul nearby and be drawn to it along the root.

name: Beating Fetter
description: Close a fetter on the pulse of an opponent's life so that its force beats slower.

name: Life Gauge
description: Gauge through a root how much life remains in a wounded soul and body.

name: Thorn Cord
description: Drive a cord set with thorns through an opponent's soul and leave it barbed.

name: Loosened Root
description: Loosen the roots of a hostile binding from an ally and let their soul and body move free of it.

name: Tendril Shackle
description: Wind tendrils round the soul until they hold it fast in a living shackle.

name: Tendril Crush
description: Tighten every tendril at once so that the soul is pressed down hard.

name: Bloom Seal
description: Let a living bloom close over an opponent's soul and seal its techniques until the bloom withers.

name: Tethered Life
description: streams: Bind Soul + Life; bind the soul of an ally whose breath has just stopped to the body with living roots so that it cannot leave in the short span in which breath can be restored.
